question: How many desktop visitors actually contact us, as opposed to opening the QR card? The delegate now skips the intercepted wa.me click on desktop; whatsapp_click fires only from the card's WhatsApp Web link and phone_copy (now a lead event, with cta=desktop-card) from its copy button.
Does lead_events overstate lead_persons because one tap fires two or three click events? The delegate drops a repeat of the same href within one second.

Which channel each visitor and lead came from (Google, Direct, AI assistants such as chatgpt.com, Social, Referral, and GBP or WhatsApp once those links carry utm_source), and how many lead persons the Karachi city filter drops each week, by city. Collector-side buckets on existing properties; no new client event.

Is a page's scroll median real or one or two people? scroll_p50 is now null under min_scroll_leaves pageleaves. Do empty-city visitors belong to Karachi? Empty city now also needs a Pakistan device timezone. Do out-of-city booking completions exist? booking_steps carries a city column and no city filter. Three internal ids added to test_distinct_ids after the analyst found them in the desktop and commercial rows.

Which FAQ question is opened before a lead or an abandon, grouped as one value across pages? The delegate now strips the text chevron glyph and collapses whitespace from the button text, so the price list, annual page and new-construction page questions group with the SVG-chevron pages.

Do Instagram bio-link and Facebook visits reach the Social bucket when the referrer is bit.ly or empty? Collector-side: the channel rule now also matches utm_source instagram, facebook, fb, linkedin, tiktok, youtube, twitter and x (gbp already matched).
A recurring Mac Chrome desktop id (three separate days, Search Console referrer, seen on the cleaning pages) added to test_distinct_ids so desktop lead persons read clean.
Which starting-price card gets tapped on the price list? The delegate now reads the card's own heading (for example Termite treatment) instead of the group heading above the cards.

How many desktop visitors are the team checking links after a deploy, and how much of the all-city count is a crawler? Three link-walking desktop ids seen right after the 2026-09-17 footer commits are added to test_distinct_ids; collector-side, a Linux desktop visitor geolocated to the AWS regions Boardman or Columbus that sweeps ten pages a second with a fresh id each week is excluded by shape, since it cannot be listed by id.
